el-faro-lighthouse-climb.pitch: Walk the spiral stair to the lamp room and see the whole island from the gallery.
description: El Faro is the oldest thing in the park and the reason the park is where it is. The climb is a walk, not a ride: a spiral stair past the keeper's quarters and the old logbooks, up to the lamp room and the open gallery around it.

Take it at your own pace. Most people spend about twenty minutes, longer near sunset when the gallery faces straight into it. There is no height requirement and no line to skip, so it is not part of Paso Rapido.
tips: The stair is outdoors at the top. The gallery stays open in rain but the view goes with the weather.
Go up in the last hour before closing to watch the plaza lanterns come on from above.
